name: spinocerebellar ataxia type 35
description: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 35 (SCA35) is a subtype of autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia type 1 (ADCA type 1) characterized by the adult-onset of progressive gait and limb ataxia, dysarthria, ocular dysmetria, intention tremor, hyperreflexia and spasmodic torticollis.
